title: Gauge: decorative scale ticks

complexity.rationale: Deciding how many major/minor ticks to generate for each of three density levels, spaced evenly across an arbitrary [minScaleValue, maxScaleValue] range, is new logic with a real design decision - it isn't a straight repeat of the angle math already built for the value/target markers.

summary: Adds an optional ticks prop to Gauge that renders decorative graduation marks along the arc, purely visual, to help readers gauge the scale without reading exact values.
requirements: Accept a ticks setting of 'minimal', 'normal', or 'dense', controlling how many graduation marks render along the arc.
Ticks are evenly spaced across the [minScaleValue, maxScaleValue] range and do not encode any data value themselves - they are purely decorative scale markers.
'normal' and 'dense' include a visually distinct minor tick between each pair of major ticks; 'dense' places more minor ticks between majors than 'normal'.
Ticks render along the inner edge of the arc and do not overlap the needle, fill, or center text.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: tick spacing still produces a reasonable, evenly distributed set of marks rather than clustering or overlapping
tick length and spacing scale down proportionally with the rendered arc rather than overlapping each other
tick color remains a fixed neutral token that stays visible against both, matching the arc track's existing fixed-token convention

crossCutting.notes: requiresNewSignalOrScale: generating major/minor tick positions across the scale range and mapping each to an arc angle is new derived data, distinct from the single current-value angle already computed. requiresS1S2Parity is false because Gauge is S2-only.

implementationPlan.change: Add an optional ticks field ('minimal' | 'normal' | 'dense') to the public Gauge contract.
Generate an evenly-spaced set of major/minor tick values across the scale range for the selected density, and map each to an arc angle.
Render the generated ticks as short marks along the arc's inner edge.
Expose ticks on the public GaugeProps.
Add stories for each tick density.

openQuestions: Exact major/minor tick counts per density level are not yet pinned down and need a design decision.

planning/specs/schema.json's chartType enum has no 'gauge' value; this spec uses the 'chart' fallback until 'gauge' is added (ideally to the pre-alpha list), at which point this file should move to planning/specs/pre-alpha/gauge/.
